headlines.title: Top 3 Dividend Stocks With Yields Over 3%
headlines.summary: Record third quarter profits from Valero’s refinery operations highlight how some businesses are still throwing off substantial cash even as markets worry about war, energy prices and the AI boom. Reliable dividend payers offering more than a 3% yield with solid coverage and consistent payout histories can turn that cash into regular income. This article breaks down three such dividend heavyweights from the US market.

headlines.title: What Is Chevron (CVX) Eyeing In Iraq With The West Qurna 2 Field?
headlines.summary: Chevron (NYSE:CVX) has entered a preliminary agreement with Iraq's Oil Ministry for exclusive talks to operate the West Qurna 2 field. The deal would see Chevron take over operatorship from Russia's Lukoil at West Qurna 2, one of Iraq's supergiant oil fields. Iraqi officials have outlined an opportunity to double output at West Qurna 2 as part of the prospective Chevron operated development plan.

headlines.title: Chevron Eyes $1B Gulf Asset Sale to Focus on Growth Projects
headlines.summary: CVX explores a potential $1 billion sale of mature U.S. Gulf oil and gas assets as it shifts focus to newer offshore projects and long-term production growth.

description: Chevron Corporation, through its subsidiaries, engages in the integrated energy and chemicals operations. It operates through Upstream and Downstream segments. The Upstream segment engages in the exploration for, development, production, and transportation of crude oil and natural gas; processing, liquefaction, transportation, and regasification of liquefied natural gas; transportation of crude oil through pipelines; transportation, storage, and marketing of natural gas; carbon capture and storage; and operation of a gas-to-liquids plant. The Downstream segment refines crude oil into petroleum products; markets crude oil, refined products, and lubricants; manufactures and markets renewable fuels; transports crude oil and refined products through pipeline, marine vessel, motor equipment, and rail car; and manufactures and markets commodity petrochemicals, plastics for industrial uses, and fuel and lubricant additives. The company operates in North America, South America, Europe, Africa, Asia, and Australia. The company was formerly known as ChevronTexaco Corporation and changed its name to Chevron Corporation in May 2005. Chevron Corporation was founded in 1879 and is headquartered in Houston, Texas.
